description: Taxis Dispatched at Port Authority of NY NJ Airports: Beginning 2002 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey quarterly produces a data file and provides information on monthly passengers Taxi Dispatch counts at John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, and Newark Liberty International Airport beginning in 2002. Taxi dispatch counts include only medallion taxis that transport passengers from these airports to a destination. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are the port authority of new york & new jersey, taxi dispatch, ground transportation, airport. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey. The portal shows 2015-07-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
